evidence_rule: Same as acceptance-matrix.json: every required reference must resolve to collected JUnit test cases and pass in both isolated repetitions; missing or skipped required coverage blocks the gate. A reference in the sentinel suite "UNCOVERED" can never resolve: a cell carrying a recorded gap therefore resolves to "missing" and blocks the gate, so a partially covered cell can never read as passed. A cell with no test and a gap resolves to "unexecuted" and blocks. Gaps are left visible, not waived, not marked N/A.
extra_keys_note: The keys gap, note, reuses_v1_6_scenarios, test_files, assessment, coverage_class, suite_sources, invariant_register, result_vocabulary are ignored by tools/release_gate.py resolve_matrix (it reads id, tests, required, coverage_scope, classification, expected only), so the file resolves with that tool unchanged.

result_vocabulary.NOT_ASSESSED: at least one tuple test is defined for the invariant; none was executed by this change; no uncovered part is recorded
